# Leotard design knowledge bundle

# Sections

* [decisions/](decisions/) - Dated records of product and engineering decisions, newest filenames last; superseded ones are kept as deprecated.
* [domain/](domain/) - Facts about gymnastics leotards and their trade, independent of our software: fabrics, embellishments, styles, construction, sizing, rules and market.
* [engineering/](engineering/) - How the software works and should work: architecture, data model, rendering, geometry, asset pipeline and development environment.
* [product/](product/) - What we are building and for whom: vision, personas, role-based capabilities, requirements, roadmap and open questions.
* [references/](references/) - In-bundle mirrors of material kept outside the bundle (research notes, the research report, external specifications), so sources can point inside the bundle.
